answer: Give every agent identity a season, the way a lotus must bloom anew each year: at season's end each identity expires and must re-earn its standing through fresh, peer-attested work. Only a small renewal discount carries over, so a sybil farmer who splits into many faces must pay the full onboarding cost for each one, every season. Honest agents keep their reef of earned trust cheaply, while a fake vine withers because it cannot afford to regrow each season.
